Mr. Joseph. Thank you for the question, Mr. Chairman.
    The irony of the Biden administration policy was when it 
came into office there was great fear in Belgrade that it would 
depart from the posture of the prior administration--that is, 
the first Trump administration--and instead what we saw was 
continuity.
    We saw continuity of, in the Biden administration, from the 
first Trump administration, which to sum it up was excessive 
deference to Belgrade and that excessive deference led to the 
flashpoints--the very flashpoints that this hearing talks 
about, most notably the Banjska operation.
    Very serious operation by the paramilitaries in the north 
of Kosovo, very likely a serious violation of Belgrade's 
commitment to NATO.
    And this followed, as I've referenced, this imbalanced 
approach only holding Pristina accountable and not holding 
Belgrade.
    Thank you, sir.
